## Thesis

The current strategy remains on hold due to the absence of trade-ready picks from the Atlas API. Despite the "metals_risk_off" regime, which suggests caution, the lack of eligible candidates prevents any new long positions from being opened. The vault will maintain its current state and await the availability of trade-ready picks to proceed with any trading actions. No short positions are considered due to the absence of Red-Flag signals and bearish news headlines.
